name: Bloodletting
description: Sacrifice 4 base health to restore 25 base mana. Health-cost reduction applies. Health costs can kill you. A shortfall of up to 0.5 health leaves 0.1 health.

name: Transfusion
description: Sacrifice 4 base health to heal a friendly player or owned creature for 8 base health. Requires an injured ally; cannot target yourself. Health costs can kill you. A shortfall of up to 0.5 health leaves 0.1 health.

name: Clot
description: Regenerate 0.2 base health per second for 30 base seconds. Taking health damage ends regeneration. Targets an ally, otherwise yourself.

name: Blood Scent
description: Sense wounded creatures as private red pulses for 60 base seconds. Maximum base reach is 64 blocks; bonus buff potency strongly increases reach: +50% gives 192 blocks and +100% gives 320, capped at 512. More severe wounds can be sensed farther away. Click the buff off to stop.

name: Blood Missiles
description: Sacrifice 3 base health to launch three staggered seeking blood missiles, each dealing 8 base piercing damage. Requires a visible enemy. Basic Hemomancy attunement required. Health costs can kill you. A shortfall of up to 0.5 health leaves 0.1 health.

name: Crimson Aegis
description: Sacrifice 4 base health to shield yourself or an ally against 10 base damage for 60 base seconds. Remaining shielding is lost on expiry. Basic Hemomancy attunement required. Health costs can kill you. A shortfall of up to 0.5 health leaves 0.1 health.

name: Red Harvest
description: Mark an enemy for 20 base seconds. If it dies, divide 12 base healing among injured allies within 8 blocks. No items are dropped. Basic Hemomancy attunement required.

name: Open Wound
description: Curse an enemy for 12 base seconds. Moving deals 1 base injury damage per block travelled, limited to 2 blocks per second. Standing still avoids this damage. Basic Hemomancy attunement required.

name: Exsanguinate
description: Hold a staff cast to drain 4 base health per second from a visible enemy, healing yourself for half the health actually removed. Costs 20 base mana to start and 8 base mana per second. Maximum channel 20 seconds. Advanced Hemomancy attunement required.

name: Heartburst
description: Sacrifice 35% of your current health before health-cost reduction. Each health point actually paid deals 1.5 base injury damage to enemies within 8 blocks and line of sight. Advanced Hemomancy attunement required.

name: Crimson Host
description: Invest 12 base health to conjure three blood goobers for 120 base seconds. They follow and attack nearby enemies for 4 base damage. Dismiss the caster buff to recall survivors: each refunds 75% of its actual invested health, scaled by its remaining health. Dead goobers refund nothing. Advanced Hemomancy attunement required. Health costs can kill you. A shortfall of up to 0.5 health leaves 0.1 health.
